Ratelimiting - No of Post that user can post
- Pre Computing the feed during write time
- new post is deliverd to friends cache immediately after it is published
- Fetching is fast beause it is precomputed
- If users have too many frnds generating the feed for all of them are slow and time consuming --> HotKey Problem.
- for inactive users or for those who rarely log in pre computing new feeds waste computing resources
- New Feed is generated during the read time(On demand model)
- For Inactive users or those who rarely login fanout on read works better.
- Fetch new feed is slow as it is not pre computed
Soln --> we choose the push model for majority of users
for people with many followers --> pull new content on demand to avoid system overload.
Consistent hashing helps to solve the hotkey problem as it helps to distribute the data more evenly
